values.note: $30 a night at every single RV site (50-amp electric and water); the two double sites (8, 37) $60; primitive tent sites A-I $12. Every vehicle, RVs included, must display the area's own $5 daily parking pass (Georgia State Parks' ParkPass and the Lands Pass are not accepted); for registered campers one daily pass covers the whole stay.

values.note: 36 electric RV sites on the booking site (2-37; 8 and 37 are doubles for two rigs), 40-60 ft except site 21 ('Short Site 18 Feet'), so 35 take a 23-ft rig; plus 9 primitive tent sites (A-I) and a group camp. The area's page says '37 RV campsites (2 sites are double campsites) and 9 tent campsites'. Campground road is one-way, counter-clockwise; site 37 must be backed in.

sites.source: https://reservations.gooutdoorsgeorgia.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=8 (MaxEquipLength per unit); https://georgiawildlife.com/rocky-mountain-pfa; campground rules PDF ('Vehicular traffic in the campground is one way, counter-clockwise only', 'CAMPSITE 37: CAMPERS/RV'S MUST BE BACKED IN'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Every site is booked through Go Outdoors Georgia (Georgia DNR's licensing and reservation site), online or at 1-800-366-2661. 14 consecutive nights, then 7 nights away. No monthly camping. Campground gate closes at 10 pm (no re-entry); check-out noon. Alcohol is prohibited anywhere on the area.

note: Georgia DNR Wildlife Resources Public Fishing Area campground NW of Rome (4054 Big Texas Valley Rd) on Antioch Lake, part of the Rocky Mountain Project lakes. The land is owned by Oglethorpe Power; Wildlife Resources runs the area and books the campground. Beach, boat ramps (idle-only lakes), lakeside primitive tent sites. Heath Lake is open to fishing only the 1st-10th of each month. --Claude
summary: Go Outdoors Georgia (GA DNR's own engine; facID=8) still books it; Wildlife Resources runs it on Oglethorpe Power land, so state stays. Engine: 36 RV units (2-37, two doubles), all 50 A + water (no sewer), 40-60 ft except 18-ft site 21 (35 fit); $30 single / $60 double / $12 tent (stored 30 confirmed). The $5 RMPFA parking pass (once per stay for campers; ParkPass and Lands Pass not accepted) moved from the fees note into fees.entrance. Count 36, max 40 -> 60 (the note's '40-ft max' was wrong), 14-night max, booking url/note. Note cleaned of the count, price, hookups and length. Season not stated anywhere; left. Pin ~140 m from the site centroid (34.3603,-85.3171) - fine. Phone 706-802-5087 confirmed ('Main Office').
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront): the engine tags nine RV sites 'Waterfront' - 26, 27, 28, 32-36 and double 37 (GIS 34.3596-34.3607,-85.3157 to -85.3173), besides tent sites A, C, D, G; every unit is tagged 'Water View'. On imagery the campground fills a wooded point in Antioch Lake: the east-side sites 34-37 sit within ~10-30 m of the shore under full canopy; 26-28 are ~60-80 m back on the south side. Needs the gate's look.
